name.text: Graphing a bounded compound inequality for a bakery's production capacity

questiontext.text:
A local bakery in {@place@} has a maximum daily production capacity of {@max_val@} loaves of bread. Today, the bakery received an urgent order for {@min_val@} loaves that must be baked and delivered by evening.

Let \( l \) represent the total number of loaves the bakery produces today.

a) Write a compound inequality to represent the number of loaves the bakery can produce today to fulfill the order without exceeding its maximum capacity.

(Enter the numerical bounds in the boxes below.)

[[input:ans1]] \( \le l \le \) [[input:ans2]]

Lower Limit: [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]
Upper Limit: [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

b) Represent this solution interval on the number line below. Drag the two blue points to the correct boundary values.

(Note: Both constraints are inclusive (\(\le\)), so closed, shaded circles are used for both ends of the segment.)

[[jsxgraph input-ref-ans3="rP1" input-ref-ans4="rP2" width="600px" height="120px"]] var min_val = {#min_val#}; var max_val = {#max_val#}; var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { /* Scale the bounding box to perfectly frame the hundreds values */ boundingbox: [min_val - 30, 2, max_val + 30, -2], axis: false, grid: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, pan: {enabled: false}, zoom: {enabled: false} }); /* Draw the number line axis with increments of 10 */ var xaxis = brd.create('axis', [[0, 0], [1, 0]], { name: 'l', withLabel: true, label: {position: 'rt', offset: [-5, 15]}, firstArrow: true, lastArrow: true, strokeWidth: 1.5, ticks: { drawLabels: true, label: {offset: [0, -15]}, insertTicks: false, ticksDistance: 10, minorTicks: 0, majorHeight: 10 } }); /* Create an invisible track segment to prevent gliders from hitting the arrowheads */ var track = brd.create('segment', [[min_val - 25, 0], [max_val + 25, 0]], {visible: false}); /* Create two interactive gliders attached to the invisible track */ var p1 = brd.create('glider', [min_val - 20, 0, track], { name: '', size: 5, strokeColor: '#1565c0', fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2, snapToGrid: true, snapSizeX: 10 }); var p2 = brd.create('glider', [max_val + 20, 0, track], { name: '', size: 5, strokeColor: '#1565c0', fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2, snapToGrid: true, snapSizeX: 10 }); /* Draw the bounded segment connecting the two gliders */ brd.create('segment', [p1, p2], { strokeWidth: 4, strokeColor: '#1565c0', highlight: false }); /* Bind the points to hidden STACK inputs */ stack_jxg.bind_point(rP1, p1); stack_jxg.bind_point(rP2, p2); stack_jxg.starts_moved(p1); stack_jxg.starts_moved(p2); [[/jsxgraph]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution:

Part a: The algebraic Solution

The bakery must produce at least \({@min_val@}\) loaves to satisfy the urgent order, which means \( l \ge {@min_val@} \).

However, the bakery cannot exceed its daily capacity of \({@max_val@}\) loaves, which means \( l \le {@max_val@} \).

Combining these two conditions into a single compound inequality gives:

\( \displaystyle \boxed{{@ta1@} \le l \le {@ta2@}} \)

Part b: Graphical Representation

To represent this on a number line, we plot a closed circle at \({@ta1@}\) and another closed circle at \({@ta2@}\). We then draw a solid line segment connecting the two circles to show that all values between \({@ta1@}\) and \({@ta2@}\) are included in the solution.

[[jsxgraph width="600px" height="120px"]] var min_val = {#min_val#}; var max_val = {#max_val#}; var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [min_val - 30, 2, max_val + 30, -2], axis: false, grid: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, pan: {enabled: false}, zoom: {enabled: false} }); var xaxis = brd.create('axis', [[0, 0], [1, 0]], { name: 'l', withLabel: true, label: {position: 'rt', offset: [-5, 15]}, firstArrow: true, lastArrow: true, strokeWidth: 1.5, ticks: { drawLabels: true, label: {offset: [0, -15]}, insertTicks: false, ticksDistance: 10, minorTicks: 0, majorHeight: 10 } }); var p1 = brd.create('point', [min_val, 0], {visible: false}); var p2 = brd.create('point', [max_val, 0], {visible: false}); brd.create('segment', [p1, p2], {strokeWidth: 4, strokeColor: '#1565c0', highlight: false}); brd.create('point', [min_val, 0], {name: '', size: 5, strokeColor: '#1565c0', fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false}); brd.create('point', [max_val, 0], {name: '', size: 5, strokeColor: '#1565c0', fillColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2, fixed: true, highlight: false}); [[/jsxgraph]]
